_about: Curated-list names (lists.json) joined to OneIllinois directory ids, checked by hand against data/clubs/directory.json read 2026-10-04 (1,197 groups). Each name maps to { id, name } (the directory name for that id, so a rename shows up), or to { id: null, note } when no registered group matches; every null says why. `wrongAutoMatch` records the three automatic matches the research got wrong (DESIGN 2.1): they are never used. tag.mjs warns when an id is gone or renamed, and prints every list name with a null id on each run.
